review.notes: Full review. All six findings of the previous review (r7 at 8c93181) are repaired. Gate rerun: every check passes; depcheck 0 problems (235 roadmaps, 2262 edges), no UPWARD/CYCLE/moved line. Suggested.lean elaborates with 14 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes none of the 14 theorems; 23 elaborated signatures compared with the README. Seeded sample of 15 targets (0.1, 2.1, 3.2, 3.3, 4.7, 4.8, 4.10, 5.3, 5.4, 6.4, 6.5, 6.7, 7.4, 7.5, 7.6) checked against yu, parshin, kw, guignard, russell, conrad_geom, milne, morris1, harder, ciubotaru_harris, bhkt, fyz, li_zhang, kudla_rapoport, plus stacks and kosters for 5.7-5.8; roquette (5.3) is waived and not readable. Adversarial table with computed values for the sample, the headlines and the new degree_sensitive_chebotarev. All cross-roadmap citations resolved at main, the open heads or the board package. Findings, both P3: R01 the Dependencies blocks of Layers 0, 2, 5 and 7 omit the pinned declarations their Needs lines name; R02 the pull-request description names a consumer roadmap (FiniteFieldsAndCharacterSums) that exists nowhere, meaning CharacterSumsOverFiniteFields.
